summary_markdown:
### Schedule \& Coordination

- Thursday call planned to align on full schedule (before 2 PM, Paul traveling in afternoon)
- Whitney to build integrated plan and send to Victoria and Chris for review before Thursday
- Thursday will also finalize FAT plan day-by-day, accounting for ship dates between AeroLab and Tate

### Shipping \& Assembly Logistics

- All components ship to Tate first, then Tate ships final to Las Vegas
- AeroLab targeting \~November 20th for fan assembly shipment to Tate
  - Louver assembly (nozzle, fiberglass, swivel duct) can split off and ship earlier from one unit
  - Fan itself stays back at AeroLab until \~20th for testing
- Uprights: simple structural steel, can be fabricated in \~2 weeks; prioritize early and ship to Tate ahead of other components
- Fans not being powered up at Tate (drives too hefty, not worth the effort)
- Manual lift to be demonstrated at AeroLab before shipping; repeated once assembled on cart at Tate
  - Unit 2 (automated): gantry with chain fall lifts nozzle, pins lock it at height; gantry can be removed after pinning
  - Storage between shows: fans stay in place (their permanent home); during residency, fans move outside
- Witness/demo window: November 16–20 at AeroLab; possible same-trip visit to Tate (2 hours away)
  - Fan running demo at AeroLab, louver/swivel duct demo at Tate for second unit
  - Tate visit to be reconsidered; may be virtual/Zoom instead

### Cart Design \& Structural Coordination

- Cart design by September 18th: scope updated since AeroLab no longer fabricating; now a Tate deliverable
  - Key coordination point: upright attachment locations (to carts and to nozzle)
  - Swivel duct tracks on sides need clearance confirmation
- Paul to email Chris this week to set up Zoom and coordinate upright locations off CAD model
- Chris to communicate cart design completion date to the wider group once confirmed
- 30% design submittal (September 18th) covers:
  - S18 and S6 facility reactions and updated models
  - Reflects 24-inch trench shift
  - Walking clearances confirmed: south 4–4.5 ft, north 7 ft, sides \~6 ft; to be shown on plan drawing
  - Access door pathway not yet defined (with architects); walking room confirmed on all sides

### 4D Effects, Fog \& Leaves Testing

- 4D duct attachment meeting needed: set up for next week (Friday this week if sooner needed)
  - Paul to prepare drawing of nozzle connection points (tapped hole locations) by end of week
  - Fog holes in bottom of nozzle duct to be cut before end of week
- Fog machine ducting: prior tube extension attempts had poor results; need to experiment at AeroLab
  - Jason to discuss options with Paul; likely solution is a short chimney-style run from underside of frame
  - Paul to provide dimension from underside of assembly to inform tube length
- Leaves: likely tested in same October 20–30 window; Jason to check on spare leaf blower unit (may have been sent to venue)
- 2 Orca fog machines: estimate in hand, cost being shared; dates to be aligned to updated schedule
- Louver system testing window: October 20–30 at AeroLab
  - All controls programming, PLC parameter dialing, and 4D effects trials in this block
  - If fan ready early, use actual fan; otherwise test louver cabinet in front of existing shop fan

### Generator, No-Fly Zone \& Access

- Generator quote: original $27K jumped to \~$50K with revised dates (30th to 11th vs. 1st to 8th)
  - Paul to forward AeroLab’s quote (from Javier) for comparison; Sphere to review
  - Feeder cable lengths to be field-verified; currently estimated at \~200 ft (four 50-ft sections per run)
  - AeroLab offered to have their engineer validate the technical proposal if Sphere shares redacted version
- No-fly zone: needs update for 2-foot trench shift for both S6 and S18
  - Paul to get updated drawings to his team; ready for next discussion
  - Stage heights up to 8–10 ft from floor (deck + drum riser) to be factored in
- Las Vegas site access:
  - Parking: Lot M by guard shack; tools via loading dock or carry-in
  - License plate info required for new gate system; AeroLab to provide closer to date
  - Storage options: venue can accommodate work boxes/cases in advance; kitchen as overflow

### Next Steps

- **Build and distribute integrated schedule** (Whitney)

  Send to Victoria and Chris for review before Thursday's call.

- **Finalize FAT plan and distribute** (Paul)

  Go through day-by-day on Thursday call; package and send to all after.

- **Coordinate upright attachment locations with Chris** (Paul)

  Set up Zoom this week with CAD model to confirm upright and swivel duct clearances.

- **Prepare nozzle connection point drawing** (Paul)

  Show tapped hole locations for 4D duct inclusions and cut fog holes in nozzle bottom by end of week.

- **Update no-fly zone drawings for S6 and S18** (Paul)

  Reflect 2-foot trench shift; ready for next group discussion.

- **Forward generator quote to Sphere for comparison** (Paul)

  Javier to send; Sphere pulling costs together now.

- **Share contingent worker badge list with Dave** (Victoria)

  Chris's team to also submit names for badge processing.

- **Set up 4D duct attachment meeting**

  Target next week; Friday this week if earlier slot needed.
